summary: 电子游戏能让玩家在有反馈的任务中持续投入和练习。文章由教育研究者的亲身体验切入，介绍游戏与思维技能的关系，并用动作游戏玩家的决策实验证明速度可以提高而准确率未必下降。
logic: 比较两组玩家的决策表现

paragraphs.brief: 威斯康辛大学(Madison)教育教授James Paul Gee，几年前他六岁的儿子Sam玩Pajama Sam:在黑暗的外面不需要隐藏。
sentences: James Paul Gee, professor of education at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, played his first video game years ago when his six-year-old son Sam was playing Pajama Sam: No Need to Hide When It’s Dark Outside.
威斯康辛大学(Madison)教育教授James Paul Gee，几年前他六岁的儿子Sam玩Pajama Sam:在黑暗的外面不需要隐藏。
He wanted to play the game so he could support Sam’s problem-solving.
他想玩这个游戏这样他就可以支持萨姆解决问题了
Though Pajama Sam is not an “educational game”, it is replete with the types of problems psychologists study when they examine thinking and learning.
虽然Pajama Sam不是“教育游戏”，但是当心理学家研究思考和学习时，他们学习的问题很多。
When he saw how well the game held Sam’s attention, he wondered what sort of beast a more mature video game might be.
当他看到比赛吸引了Sam的注意力时，他想知道更成熟的游戏会是什么样的野兽。

paragraphs.brief: 许多家长视视频和电脑游戏为时间浪费者，更糟糕的是家长认为这些游戏会腐烂大脑。
sentences: Video and computer games, like many other popular, entertaining and addicting kids’ activities, are looked down upon by many parents as time-wasters, and worse, parents think that these games rot the brain.
许多家长视视频和电脑游戏为时间浪费者，更糟糕的是家长认为这些游戏会腐烂大脑。
Violent video games are readily blamed by the media and some experts as the reason why some youth become violent or commit extreme anti-social behaviour.
暴力游戏很容易被媒体和一些专家指责为是某些青年变得暴力或从事极端反社会行为的原因。
Recent content analyses of video games show that as many as 89 % of games contain some violent content, and there is some form of aggressive content in 70 % of popular games.
最近对电子游戏内容的分析表明，多达89%的游戏含有一些暴力内容，70%的流行游戏含有某种形式的攻击性内容。
Many scientists and psychologists, like James Paul Gee, find that video games actually have many benefits – the main one being making kids smart.
许多科学家和心理学家，如James Paul Gee，发现电子游戏其实有许多好处，主要是让孩子变得聪明。
Video games may actually teach kids high-level thinking skills that they will need in the future.
视频游戏实际上可能教授孩子们高级思维技能他们将在未来需要。

paragraphs.brief: 威斯康星大学心理学家 C. 肖恩·格林说：“电子游戏会改变你的大脑。”
sentences: “Video games change your brain,” according to University of Wisconsin psychologist C. Shawn Green.
威斯康星大学心理学家 C. 肖恩·格林说：“电子游戏会改变你的大脑。”
Video games alter the brain’s physical structure the same way as learning to read, playing the piano, or navigating with a map.
视频游戏改变大脑的物理结构，就像学习阅读、弹钢琴或用地图导航一样。

Much like exercise can build muscle, the powerful combination of concentration and rewarding surges of neurotransmitters like dopamine, which strengthens neural circuits, can build the player’s brain.
锻炼可以制造肌肉，集中力和奖励性强的混合神经传递器，如多巴胺，强化神经电路，能够建立玩家的大脑。

paragraphs.brief: 视频游戏让孩子的大脑真正锻炼。
sentences: Video games give your child’s brain a real workout.
视频游戏让孩子的大脑真正锻炼。
In many video games, the skills required to win involve abstract and high-level thinking.
在许多电子游戏中，赢得比赛所需的技能涉及抽象和高层次的思维。
These skills are not even taught at school.
学校甚至不教授这些技能。
Some of the mental skills trained by video games include: following instructions, problem-solving, logic, hand-eye coordination, fine-motor and spatial skills.
通过电子游戏培训的一些心理技能包括：遵循指令、解决问题、逻辑、亲眼协调、细运动和空间技能。
Research also suggests that people can learn iconic, spatial, and visual attention skills from video games.
研究还表明，人们可以从电子游戏中学习标志性、空间性和视觉关注技能。
There have even been studies with adults showing that experience with video games is related to better surgical skills.
甚至对成年人的研究显示，电子游戏的经验与更好的外科技能有关。
Jacob Benjamin, a doctor from Beth Israel Medical Center, NY, found a direct link between skill at video gaming and skill at keyhole or laparoscopic surgery.
Jacob Benjamin是纽约Beth Israel医疗中心的一位医生，他发现了视频游戏技巧与钥匙孔或腹腔外科手术技巧之间的直接联系。
Also, a reason given by experts as to why fighter pilots of today are more skilful is that this generation’s pilots were weaned on video games.
专家也指出为何今日的战斗机飞行员更熟练，是因为这代飞行员在电子游戏上断奶。
F The players learn to manage resources that are limited and decide the best use of those resources, just as in real life.
F 参与者学会管理有限的资源，并决定如何最佳地利用这些资源，就像在现实生活中一样。
In strategy games, for instance, while developing a city, an unexpected surprise like an enemy might emerge.
例如，在战略游戏中，在开发城市时，可能出现出乎意料的意外，就像敌人。
This forces the player to be flexible and quickly change tactics, sometimes almost every second of the game, giving the brain a real workout.
这迫使玩家灵活和迅速改变战术，有时几乎每秒游戏，给大脑一个真正的锻炼。

According to researchers at the University of Rochester led by Daphne Bavelier, a cognitive scientist, games simulating stressful events such as those found in battle or action games could be a training tool for real-world situations.
由认知科学家Daphne Bavelier率领的罗切斯特大学的研究人员认为，模拟战斗或动作游戏中发现的那种紧张事件游戏可以成为现实世界局势的培训工具。
The study suggests that playing action video games primes the brain to make quick decisions.
研究显示玩动作游戏使大脑能快速做出决定
Video games can be used to train soldiers and surgeons, according to the study.
根据这项研究，可以使用视频游戏来培训士兵和外科医生。

Steven Johnson, author of Everything Bad Is Good for You: How Today’s Popular Culture Is Actually Making Us Smarter, says gamers must deal with immediate problems while keeping their long-term goals on the horizon.
游戏者必须处理眼前的问题并保持他们的长期目标地平线：“史蒂文·约翰逊，《每件事都对你不好》的作者：今天的流行文化如何实际上使我们更聪明。”
Young gamers force themselves to read to get instructions, follow storylines of games, and glean information from the game texts.
年轻游戏家强迫自己阅读指令，遵循游戏的故事线，并从游戏文本中收集信息。
G James Paul Gee says that playing a video game is similar to working through a science problem.
G James Paul Gee说玩电子游戏和处理科学问题相似
Like students in a laboratory, gamers must come up with a hypothesis.
像实验室里的学生一样游戏家必须提出一个假设
For example, players in some games constantly try out combinations of weapons and powers to defeat an enemy.
例如，一些游戏的玩家不断尝试把武器和力量结合起来，以打败敌人。
If one does not work, they change the hypothesis and try the next one.
如果一个人不工作，他们改变假设并尝试下一个。
Video games are goal-driven experiences, says Gee, which are fundamental to learning.
Gee说，视频游戏是目标驱动的经验，是学习的基础。
Also, using math skills is important to win in many games that involve quantitative analysis such as managing resources.
此外，在涉及资源管理等定量分析的许多游戏中，使用数学技能对于赢得比赛很重要。
In higher levels of a game, players usually fail the first time around, but they keep on trying until they succeed and move on to the next level.
在更高级的游戏中，玩家通常第一次失败，但他们继续尝试直到成功，并进入下一个级别。
H Many games are played online and involve cooperation with other online players in order to win.
H 许多游戏在网上播放，并与其他在线玩家合作以赢得比赛。
Video and computer games also help children gain self-confidence, and many games are based on history, city-building, and governance, and so on.
视频和计算机游戏也有助于儿童获得自信，许多游戏都基于历史、城市建设和治理等等。
Such games indirectly teach children about various aspects of life on Earth.
这种游戏间接地教育儿童了解地球上生活的各个方面。

I In an upcoming study in the journal Current Biology, authors Daphne Bavelier, Alexandre Pouget and C. Shawn Green report that video games could provide a potent training regimen for speeding up reactions in many real-life situations.
在即将发表于《当代生物学》的一项研究中，达芙妮·巴韦利耶、亚历山大·普热和 C. 肖恩·格林报告说，电子游戏可以作为一种有效的训练手段，帮助人们在许多现实情境中更快作出反应。
The researchers tested dozens of 18- to 25-year-olds who were not ordinarily video-game players.
研究人员测试了几十名18至25岁的人，他们通常不是视频游戏玩家。
They split the subjects: one group played 50 hours of the fast-paced action video game Unreal Tournament, and the other group played 50 hours of the slow-moving strategy game The Sims 2.
他们分开了主题：一个小组玩了50小时的快速动作游戏非真实比赛，另一个小组玩了 " 慢动作战略 " 游戏的50小时 " Sims 2 "。
After this training period, all subjects were asked to make quick decisions in several tasks designed by the researchers.
在这一培训阶段之后，所有科目都被要求在研究人员设计的若干任务中作出快速决定。
The action-game players were up to 25 % faster at reaching a conclusion and answered just as many questions correctly as their strategy-game-playing peers.
动作游戏玩家在达成一个结论时速度高达25%，并像他们的策略游戏同伴一样正确地回答了同样多的问题。

items.en: What is the main purpose of paragraph A?
correct: Introduction of the background of this passage.

items.en: What does the author want to express in the second paragraph?
items.zh: 提交人在第二段中想表达什么？
correct: Even though there is a certain proportion of violence in most video games, scientists and psychologists see their benefits to children’s intellectual abilities.
尽管大多数电子游戏中都有一定比例的暴力，但科学家和心理学家认为，暴力对儿童智力能力有利。

items.en: What is correctly mentioned in paragraph D?
correct: Some surgeons have better skills because they play more video games.
有些外科医生有更好的技能因为他们玩更多的电子游戏。

items.en: What is the finding of the experiment the three researchers conducted in the last paragraph?
items.zh: 上一段中三名研究人员的实验结果是什么？
correct: Video games help increase the speed of players’ reactions effectively.
视频游戏有助于有效提高玩家反应的速度。

items.en: Most video games are popular because of their violent content.
items.zh: 大多数电子游戏都因其暴力内容而受欢迎。
items.why: 统计说明许多游戏含暴力元素，也说明热门游戏中很常出现攻击内容。两者共存不能证明游戏受欢迎正是因为暴力。

items.en: It would be a good idea for schools to apply video games in their classrooms.
items.zh: 学校最好在教室里应用电子游戏。
items.why: 作者说游戏可能教会孩子将来需要的思维技能，但没有据此主张学校应在课堂上使用电子游戏。

items.en: Those people who are addicted to video games have lots of dopamine in their brains.
items.zh: 那些对电子游戏上瘾的人脑子里有很多多巴胺
items.why: 原文说玩游戏时多巴胺等递质会短时大量释放，讨论对象是玩家。文中没有测量成瘾者平时的多巴胺水平。

items.en: The action-game players minimised the percentage of mistakes in the experiment.
items.zh: 动作游戏玩家将实验中错误的百分比最小化。
items.why: 段落 1明言“动作游戏组的正确率与策略游戏组一样 (answered just as many questions correctly)”,并未“减少错误率”或“更少错误”,所以陈述与原文矛盾。

items.en: Video games, like other daily-life skills, alter the brain’s physical structure.
items.zh: 电子游戏和其他日常生活技能一样，改变大脑的物理结构。

items.en: The brain is ready to make decisions without hesitation when players are immersed in stressful games.
items.zh: 当玩家沉浸在压力的游戏中时，大脑可以毫不犹豫地作出决定。

items.en: The purpose-motivated experience that video games offer plays an essential role in studying.
items.zh: 电子游戏提供的有目的的经验在学习中起着重要作用。

items.en: Players are good at tackling immediate issues while keeping future intentions in mind.
items.zh: 玩家善于处理眼前的问题，同时牢记未来的意图。

items.en: Video games help children broaden their horizons in many aspects and gain self-confidence.
items.zh: 视频游戏有助于儿童在许多方面拓宽视野并获得自信。

pairs: 原文用日常说法“让孩子更聪明”，题干用较正式的“有益于儿童智力”。
题干的“果断作出决定”对应原文的“迅速决断”，都在概括压力情境训练对反应速度的作用。
两个复合形容词都指游戏体验受明确目标引导，goal 在这里与 purpose 对应。
points: 统计说明许多游戏含暴力元素，也说明热门游戏中很常出现攻击内容。两者共存不能证明游戏受欢迎正是因为暴力。
题干问“电子游戏和其他日常生活技能一样，改变大脑的物理结构”。定位句写到“视频游戏改变大脑的物理结构，就像学习阅读、弹钢琴或用地图导航一样”。
clauses: … ”, it is replete with the types of problems psychologists study when they examine thinking and learning.
连接词 though 引出“Though Pajama Sam is not an “educational game”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。
Video and computer games, like many other popular, entertaining and addicting kids’ activities, are looked down upon by many parents as time-wasters, and worse, parents think ….
“that these games rot the brain”补足 think 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 think 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
